name: Medical Societies - CPD/Outcomes Portals

pain_points: GMC revalidation requires outcomes evidence, not just attendance
Accreditation audits demand proof of behavior change and clinical impact
Current LMS platforms only track completions, not learning outcomes
Manual aggregation of member reflection notes for audit reports
Difficult to demonstrate CPD value to members at AGM/renewal time
Regulators want evidence of 'learning gained and effect on practice'
buying_signals: AGM reporting season (need to show member value)
Membership renewal period (justify fees with outcomes)
Complaints about existing LMS lacking outcomes

fit_logic.proceed: They have members requiring CPD for professional registration (GMC, Royal College, etc.), conduct accreditation audits, and need to demonstrate outcomes beyond completion certificates.
fit_logic.park: Organization doesn't have regulatory CPD requirements or is satisfied with completion-only tracking
fit_logic.stop: Expect Yoke to create CPD content or deliver courses (we provide measurement layer only)

what_they_sell: Professional membership with CPD/CME programs for regulatory compliance (GMC revalidation, Royal College standards)
what_proof_means: Outcomes evidence for accreditation audits: confidence shifts, clinical decision impact, behavior change over time, reflection analytics - all required for GMC revalidation and Royal College standards.
yoke_strengths: Measures outcomes, not just completions (exactly what GMC/Royal Colleges require)
Automated reflection and learning impact tracking (vs manual notes)
Accreditation-ready reports (behavior change, confidence, decision impact)
Always-on portal (members self-serve, no society admin overhead)
Standard CPD templates (no custom content creation per society)
yoke_weaknesses: If they expect us to create CPD content (we're measurement layer, not content provider)
If society has no regulatory pressure (optional CPD only)
Very small societies (<50 members) may not have budget

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke helps medical societies meet GMC revalidation and accreditation requirements with automated outcomes measurement - proving behavior change and clinical impact, not just course completions.
key_benefits: Satisfy GMC revalidation requirements with outcomes evidence (not just attendance)
Pass accreditation audits with automated behavior change reporting
Demonstrate member value at AGM with confidence shifts and decision impact data
Reduce admin burden - members self-serve, automated reflection aggregation
Justify membership fees by showing real learning outcomes
messaging.elevator_pitch: GMC revalidation requires outcomes evidence, but most LMS platforms only track completions. Yoke provides the outcomes layer - measuring confidence shifts, clinical decisions, and behavior change - so your CPD programs satisfy accreditation audits and demonstrate real member value.

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase member value and retention with outcomes-based CPD that satisfies revalidation requirements
two_lever_framing.lever_b: Reduce admin burden and accreditation risk by automating outcomes measurement and reflection aggregation

current_tools: Generic LMS (Moodle, TalentLMS) + manual reflection notes
competitor_gap.what_they_do: Track course completions, issue certificates of attendance, store manual reflection notes, monitor credit accumulation
competitor_gap.what_they_dont_do: Measure behavior change, track clinical decision impact, show confidence shifts over time, demonstrate patient outcomes, provide automated outcomes evidence for accreditation audits
competitor_gap.failure_moment: Annual accreditation audit: Regulator asks for evidence that CPD activities led to behavior change and improved clinical practice. Society can only show attendance certificates and disconnected reflection notes. Auditor flags gaps in outcomes evidence.
competitor_gap.consequence: Failed accreditation (lose ability to award CPD credits) or conditional pass requiring remediation plan. Loss of member trust and value proposition.
competitor_gap.clock: Annual accreditation audits (Q1-Q2), GMC revalidation cycles (5-year), AGM reporting (quarterly/annual)

deadline_triggers.signal: Members approaching revalidation deadline, need outcomes evidence
deadline_triggers.source: GMC requires 250 CPD credits per 5-year cycle with reflection on learning and impact

deadline_triggers.signal: CPD Standards Office or Royal College accreditation review scheduled
deadline_triggers.source: IACPDA/ACCME standards require outcome assessment of educational activities

deadline_triggers.signal: AGM approaching, need to demonstrate member value and CPD impact
deadline_triggers.source: Membership renewal season, justify fees with outcomes

deadline_triggers.signal: Renewal period, members questioning value of CPD programs
deadline_triggers.source: Annual membership fees £115-£330, need to show ROI

components: Standard CPD module templates (upload existing content)
standard_rollout.proof_of_delivery: Medscape outcomes measurement + Awards for enterprise credibility
standard_rollout.description: Society uploads existing CPD content to templates. Members access portal, complete modules with built-in outcomes measurement. Automated analytics generate accreditation reports. No content creation or custom builds required.

icp_score.rationale: PERFECT SCORE. Regulatory pain (GMC revalidation mandatory), hard deadlines (annual audits, 5-year cycles), standard product (CPD templates, no custom per society), buyers easily reachable (CEO/Education Director in small orgs), evidence fast to validate (public accreditation requirements, discovery calls).
icp_score.validation_source: Web research: GMC guidance, Royal College standards, CPD accreditation requirements, LMS competitor analysis

target_segments.rationale: Direct buyer access, clear pain, fast decisions
Larger revenue per deal, committee sales process
Enterprise sale, long cycle, but huge impact and reference

first_5_targets.strategy: Start with small specialty societies (100-500 members) for fast wins and proof, then use as references for mid-size bodies

targets.research_needed: List UK specialty societies in dermatology, rheumatology, cardiology, oncology, etc.
Dietetics, podiatry, radiography, paramedics professional bodies
targets.search_method: Sheffield Hallam allied health professional bodies list

targets.research_needed: Royal College regional chapters (Scotland, Wales, specific regions)

validation_evidence.quote: Recording of CPD activity should include reflection of the learning gained and likely effect on professional work
Certificates of attendance may prove attendance but say nothing about what has been learned or any changes made as a result
validation_evidence.validates: Failure of current tools (attendance certificates insufficient)

validation_evidence.quote: The majority of accredited CPD activities do not target clinical behavior change. Evidence linking CPD directly to patient outcomes remains limited.
validation_evidence.validates: Competitor gap (current CPD doesn't measure behavior change)

validation_evidence.source: Academy of Medical Royal Colleges Standards
validation_evidence.quote: IACPDA standards require outcome assessment of educational activity
